$comment: Seed data for the openconnector register, applied at app install/upgrade via ConfigurationService::importFromApp(). Per REQ-A-007 (openspec/changes/openconnector-register-schema-declaration), this file ships 3-5 seed objects per mutable config schema; log schemas (call_log, job_log, synchronization_log, synchronization_contract_log) are append-only at runtime and MUST NOT appear here. All secret-bearing fields (apikey, password, secret, jwt, authenticationConfig) use safe placeholders ("YOUR_API_KEY_HERE", "<placeholder>", or the all-zero UUID). Operators replace the placeholders via the OpenConnector admin UI or via Configuration export/import (ADR-015). Chain B's storage migration translates any pre-existing rows in oc_openconnector_* legacy tables into OR objects; that migration is NOT driven by this seed file.
